caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical container with a detailed, faceted body made up of repeating geometric star patterns, rendered primarily in shades of yellow, green, and light blue. The surface of the container’s body shows the facets reflecting light with various tints. The upper part of the container features a metallic-looking lid, colored in silver and gray tones with some white highlights indicating shine. The lid is topped with a finial made of a looped ring structure adorned with small circular elements along the perimeter and a central design that includes two small leaf shapes. The overall composition is centered on a plain, light beige background and there are no other objects or elements present.
title: Jelly Jar
